action_items: No code changes required. Co-owner portal view (/my-ownership) and owner portfolio summary (/ownership-portfolio) work end-to-end on preview backend + Expo web frontend.

Known preview-only behaviour: Resend only delivers to the sandbox address delivered@resend.dev; sending statements to arbitrary emails (incl. own7b068e@example.com) lands in failed[] with sent:[]. The coowner_statements doc is still persisted so the owner trail is correct, but /my-ownership will NOT list that year for the co-owner (filter requires their email in sent[]). This is working as designed - just worth documenting.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/ownership_views.py:16-20 _my_rows filters out money_access=False co_owners docs (tasks-only manager hidden) and matches on $or shares/contributions > 0 - verified.
routes/ownership_views.py:26-28 respects per-project scoping: if c['project_ids'] is a list, only those pids yield rows (so a manager tied to one project cannot see shares in another).
routes/ownership_views.py:42-43 statements filter is {'project_id': p.id, 'sent': user.email} which Mongo-matches when email is in the sent[] array - verified.
routes/ownership_views.py:55-56 /my-ownership/statement 404 when caller's email not in sent[] for that tax year - verified.

routes/ownership_views.py:69-91 /ownership/portfolio aggregates per-person contribution/profit/annual_cashflow across projects, sorts owner-first then by contribution desc, computes cash_return_pct=annual_cashflow/contribution*100 with None guard - verified against UI numbers.
frontend/app/my-ownership.tsx:46-50 statement detail fetched on tap via useMutation; same chip toggles open/closed with open?.ty check - good UX.
frontend/app/my-ownership.tsx:62-66 cash_return_pct/profit_return_pct line is rendered only when at least one is non-null; the ' · ' separator is conditional on both.
frontend/app/ownership-portfolio.tsx:26 person card testID uses `ownership-person-${p.key}` where key is co_owner_id or literal 'owner' (set in backend 79) - matches spec exactly.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Preview env uses EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (not EXPO_BACKEND_URL) in frontend/.env. Backend login JSON uses 'access_token'. Project activation endpoint is POST /api/projects/{pid}/activate (no body). Resend only delivers to delivered@resend.dev on this account; to test co-owner statement visibility against any other email, send then update the coowner_statements doc 'sent' array in Mongo (same trick used here). The 'owner-first' sort order in /ownership/portfolio means people[0].is_owner is always true when the owner has any contribution or share.
